item.description:

可调范围随机图为探索几何如何影响量子动力学提供了多功能环境。本文研究了量子多体系统中传输和纠缠增长，其中两体相互作用由这类图编码。通过调整有效范围参数，研究人员在最近邻和全连接图之间进行插值，并识别出一种在单粒子和有限密度情况下均稳健的新局域化机制。该工作确立了可调范围随机图作为研究连通性、传输和纠缠之间相互作用的平台。

This paper proposes QCA-DenseNet, a static American Sign Language (ASL) recognition pipeline in which an eight-qubit variational circuit acts as a channel-attention gate on DenseNet121 features. item.title: Demonstration of a partial knowledge quantum key distribution protocol
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Liran Shirizly, Leonid Vidro, Hagai S. Eisenberg
arXiv:2611.10670v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We demonstrate a novel QKD protocol, named textttBridge[d,q], which generalizes the textttSARG04 protocol to d dimensions and q bases. In this protocol, Alice and Bob gain only partial knowledge about each other's raw key. Nevertheless, this partial information is sufficient to distill a definite mutual encryption key. We present an experimental demonstration of the textttBridge[2,3] protocol. The three unbiased polarization bases were switched using a single Pockels cell. The applied polarization basis switching method is relevant to any 3-basis QKD protocol and to other applications that require fast manipulation of photon polarization qubits.

item.title: Parameterized equivalence checking of quantum circuit generators via weighted automata
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Pavel Chuklanov
arXiv:2611.12049v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A generator builds a quantum circuit from the number of qubits and a bit string. We check a generator against a reference for all parameter values under six equivalence relations. For ladder programs, we prove that above a computable threshold the circuit matrices form a uniform matrix product operator, a weighted automaton of dimension independent of the number of qubits. Equivalence reduces to the zeroness of a difference automaton, checked modulo primes. The answer is a counterexample or "equal", exact or with a computed error bound. Experimentally, the method found errors missed by fixed-size checks and produced no incorrect verdicts.

📚 arXiv
👤 Caisheng Cheng
arXiv:2611.10615v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The quantum switch is a higher-order transformation that combines input quantum channels in an indefinite causal order. item.title: Singularising quantum channels preserving kappa-additivity
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Sviatoslav V. Dzhenzher
arXiv:2611.12537v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We construct quantum channels by averaging unitary shift conjugations with respect to κ-additive probability measures on measurable abelian groups. The channels act on the duals of operator algebras generated by shifts and bounded measurable multiplication operators. They preserve κ-additivity of quantum states and admit a weak-* integral representation on this class. If the averaging measure vanishes on singletons, every output state is singular. In the appendix, we also establish the corresponding Fubini's theorem for κ-additive measures.
